Implemented in modules/design/shared ReachableResponseBasis (commit 986bc5a107fd5f8d9c8ed7c4cb7a00e1ee5bb905): family sampling on a shared [0, max span] grid, unit-normalized member curves, smaller-Gram eigendecomposition via Gale Eigen.eigSymmetric, descending singular values, cumulative energy fractions, maxRank + relative eigenvalue floor truncation, and a modified Gram-Schmidt polish restoring machine-precision orthonormality near the floor. Projection returns W(theta) coefficients plus a per-rank relative span-residual receipt; truncate() keeps leading directions with identical receipts. Typed ReachableBasisError covers empty/under-sampled/multi-basis/degenerate/numeric paths.

Evidence: ReachableResponseBasisSuite 8/8 on designJVM and designJS (orthonormality 1e-8, family recovery <= 1e-5, monotone held-out residuals with rank-8 residual <= 1e-2 for an off-grid LWU kernel, basis-column unit projection, truncation receipt equality, error paths). Full designJVM/designJS suites 285/285 with local gale/intaglio overrides (-Dscalafim.gale.build, -Dscalafim.intaglio.build).

Placement decision: hrf stays Gale-free (cats+spire); design owns response-basis policy and already depends on hrf + Gale, so the constructor lives in scalafim.fmri.design. Consumer: plsneuro live response-model explorer (C2).
